issues.where: rain streaks across the entire frame (also set-C-03.png crop 9 and crop 10)
issues.what: the falling rain consists of uniform, ruler-straight white lines with crisp edges and hard endpoints that sit on top of both sharp foreground and blurred sky rather than inside the scene's depth
issues.fix: render 3D volumetric rain with depth-of-field blur, varied drop lengths and angles, soft motion-blurred tapered ends, and atmospheric fade with distance

issues.where: crop 3 and crop 4, true leaf blades and petioles (also set-C-01.png)
issues.what: the leaves have a waxy, molded-plastic sheen with painted-looking concentric green bands, and backlit leaves and petioles in crop 4 stay dark and opaque against the bright sky with almost no transmitted light
issues.fix: replace the procedural striped sheen with fine cellular epidermal roughness and raised venation, and add physically based subsurface scattering so backlit lamina and petioles transmit warm light

issues.where: crop 1, top of the central stem
issues.what: the main stem terminates in a blunt, smooth, hairless cylindrical green stub with small leaves intersecting its sides instead of an apical bud
issues.fix: model a tightly folded, densely hairy apical shoot bud at the meristem with continuous organic node transitions

issues.where: crop 2 and crop 4, lower pair of cotyledons on the stem
issues.what: both cotyledons look like smooth dark-green plastic paddles, with a single painted centerline on the left oval card and a thick grey-rimmed slab on the right intersecting directly into the cylindrical stem
issues.fix: give the cotyledons organic curvature, swollen petiole collars at the node, subtle secondary venation, natural epidermal micro-texture, and translucency

issues.where: crop 6, base of the stem where it meets the soil
issues.what: the cylindrical stem ends in an abrupt bright-rimmed cut against the dark soil with no contact shadow, root collar taper, or displaced mud
issues.fix: add ambient occlusion and contact shadowing at the soil junction, taper and stain the lower hypocotyl into a root collar, and place wet soil crumbs around the entry point

issues.where: crop 1, crop 2, and crop 4, hairs along the stem, petioles, and leaf edges
issues.what: the hairs are thick, stiff, opaque bright-white cones clumped like frost spines, missing altogether on the top stem stub and changing across an abrupt horizontal boundary at the cotyledons
issues.fix: replace spiky cones with fine, curved, semi-translucent trichomes of varied length that grade continuously along the stem, petioles, leaf margins, and bud

issues.where: crop 1, crop 3, and crop 5, leaf margins and base of the middle-right leaf blade
issues.what: several leaf margins show paper-thin polygonal straight segments, and the base of the middle-right leaf blade twists into a dark, pinched self-intersecting mesh fold
issues.fix: subdivide and thicken leaf margins with natural serration curl, and clean up the pinched mesh geometry where the middle-right petiole meets the blade

issues.where: crop 2, crop 4, and crop 6, water drops on the stem and leaves
issues.what: droplets on the vertical stem are cloudy, matte grey-green oval beads stuck symmetrically to the cylinder without clear refraction or runoff trails, while rain-pelted leaves remain mostly dry
issues.fix: use clear refractive water shaders with crisp sky reflections, gravity-pulled drop profiles, continuous wet surface sheen, and coalescing runoff along veins and stem hairs

issues.where: water furrow at bottom left-center (and set-C-02.png crop 6 left)
issues.what: multiple repeated, rigid crown-splash meshes sit lined up along the narrow puddle with stiff glassy shading
issues.fix: replace repeated static crown models with varied raindrop impact stages, asymmetric motion-blurred splashes, and overlapping muddy-water ripples

issues.where: crop 7 and crop 8, foreground grass clump and dark spiky ground plants (also set-C-02.png crop 6)
issues.what: grass blades are flat, knife-sharp ribbons in a single flat green with no veins, wetness, or contact shadow in the mud, beside jagged low-poly dark spiky plant meshes
issues.fix: add blade thickness, longitudinal ribs, natural arch, wet highlights, basal sheaths with soil contact shadows, and higher-resolution organic geometry for ground weeds and debris

issues.where: crop 7 and crop 8, wet soil surface and foreground defocus (also set-C-02.png crop 6)
issues.what: rain splash spray across the mud appears as noisy, pixelated clusters of stippled dots, and out-of-focus foreground areas at the bottom of crop 7 show grainy blotches
issues.fix: increase render samples and motion-blur substeps for fine splash mist and depth-of-field bokeh so spray and defocused soil render smoothly without stipple noise

issues.where: crop 9, midground crop field and horizon skyline band
issues.what: repeated star-shaped grass tufts line the midground row, and a uniform pale-blue horizontal band separates the field from the dark ridge like a flat backdrop strip
issues.fix: vary midground plant geometry, scale, and spacing, and replace the uniform horizon band with uneven volumetric mist integrated across terrain depth
